related.title: Linux 虛擬記憶體：頁面與內部碎片
related.titleEn: Linux virtual memory: pages and internal fragmentation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付quota-ledger.csv與不同平行度對照；數值是教學模型，不修改主機cgroup。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver quota-ledger.csv and concurrency comparisons; these are teaching fixtures without changing host cgroups. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 把位址0、4095、4096、9999拆成page index與offset；用三個任意frame重組實體位址。
related.differenceEn: Split addresses0,4095,4096,9999 into page index and offset; reconstruct physical addresses using three chosen frames.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
CPU配額限制每period可使用的累計CPU時間；多核心平行工作可更早耗盡配額。節流不是每個任務各得同一配額。
本課數值核對：50/100 = 0.5 CPU_equivalent；另一項核對：50/2 = 25 ms。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

頁表把虛擬頁映到實體頁，頁內偏移保持；向上取整的配置造成內部碎片，不等於所有位址都駐留。
本課數值核對：ceil(10000/4096) = 3 pages；另一項核對：3*4096-10000 = 2288 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A CPU quota limits accumulated CPU time per period; parallel workers can exhaust it earlier. It is not a separate quota for every task.
Numeric audit: 50/100 = 0.5 CPU_equivalent; second audit: 50/2 = 25 ms. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Page tables map virtual pages to physical frames while preserving offsets; rounded allocation creates internal fragmentation without implying all addresses are resident.
Numeric audit: ceil(10000/4096) = 3 pages; second audit: 3*4096-10000 = 2288 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
